about_the_game: Grammy-nominated composer, Austin Wintory reunites with ABZU developer Giant Squid for their newest, most ambitious title yet, The Pathless. The soundtrack features over 100 musicians recorded across the world, at the heart of which are the incredible throat singing Alash Ensemble from Tuva.
